content.premise: The party wake in Kelderby on the morning of its festival. The host opens the day on the stage, and at once everything goes wrong: the day is spent putting it right, the dusk is spent defending the feast from raiders off the sea, and the night is the festival, made of whatever the day managed.
content.theme: A cheerful harbour town on the slope below a castle mountain, on the day of its yearly festival: one main street from the cathedral square down to the quays, side streets off it, farms and pens on the flank, a lighthouse on the headland, the castle up its long road. Bright and comic: the trouble is things going wrong, never a threat, until the raiders at dusk.
content.title: Festival Day in Kelderby
